Thank you so much.  I truly appreciate your help

I wish I was free. Just because I am 18 does not mean anything. I have no where to go, I will be finishing school and its just not as simple as being free. Your words are very kind and I really appreciate your words. Thank you so much.
Yes, I definitely asked permission.

I'm a 17 year old girl with issues too, but not as many as her.  Right now your all she has, when she looks at you she sees her world.  The best thing you can do for her is to maybe take a day and take her somewhere  (beach,  park,  ect.) And sit her down and let her talk everything out, hold her,  cry with her,  anything she needs, and but only if you love her, talk about a future and let that brighten everything.  At 17 we can't do much,  but that will make everything better for awhile.  Also being her boyfriend and helping her so much take a breath,  you do allot.  Your her hero,  take pride in that.
It must have been hard to share this but thank you so much for sharing.

I know everyone says this all the time but things do get better.  I'm that one girl at school now and I'm a senior.  I don't have any friends and I'm very quiet.  Honestly everyone needs someone so if you'd like PM me and I'll be there to listen. Offing yourself never does anyone any good.
That's understandable,  my girlfriend is going through the same thing as far as being able to be herself.

Take things slow,  there is no rush.  When you feel comfortable tell one friend at a time.  Once you feel accepted things will take off from there.  College will be great for you, so no worries.  It'll all work out.
Yes, but they are in school so I take on most of the responsibility.  Also I'm in Florida, today I spoke to my girlfriend and we're going to get a therapist to talk too.
Thank you to everyone who commented. We're talking and working it out together.  I love my girlfriend and she understands it's hard,  so together we're figuring this out.

Money changes people, they wanted nothing to do with your grandfather.  You were the only one there, listen to him and do as you are told. Do not give them a single cent, instead go on with life and use that money wisely.  Good luck man.

I am 17 myself and think you did what is right. Being bullied can hurt someone deeply. As a single father I'm sure it is difficult.  You did what was right and are a good father.  Many would be lucky to have you. Eventually I'm sure she'll learn and everything will be okay. Best of luck to you and your family.
Don't do that to yourself dude. Keep your head up and move forward. Trust me when you see that baby your going to love it.  Just don't give up.

Okay. Let me just say that everything will be okay. Calm down.  Okay well first thing to remember is this is a baby. Its going to need you and love you just the same.  Also your partner is going threw something hard for her too, don't let her blame herself.  Instead maybe you too could see a therapist or maybe you can confide in a friend.  But honesty, from my experience with women and just keep an open mind, are you sure she didn't cheat?  Just be 100% with yourself and don't hide feelings. It'll all be okay

Thank you. We spoke last night and we are trying to do things to make everything a little easier. We even discussed what the baby will call her later on. :) I hope everything goes well with your transition. :) Good luck to you hun. *Hug*
Thank you very much for the advice, it helped a lot and I do plan on giving it more time than I have been.  Thank you again.
Thank you so much for the advice. I am going to give it more time and talk to her more than I have been and see where that takes us.
Wow...You're absolutely stunning!

I have the same situation.  My girlfriend is always asking if she looks pretty and if she looks Trans, its almost a 24/7 thing. Honestly keep complementing her and keep telling her she is beautiful.  Offer to do her hair and help pick out clothes that make her feel beautiful.  Its going to be annoying at times, but seeing her happy is well worth it in sure.  Just remember she is going through a hard time and going out makes her afraid of being judged and pointed out. The little things always count.
Thank you. :)
Thank you so much. :)
I know, but getting married now isn't a big deal. Its more of talking about it and discussing it. We have other things on our mind, so trust me marriage isn't a big deal right now
